help.rank: A rank estimated from this game's play; for review only, not an official rank.
help.band: A band from a separate rule of thumb; it can differ from the estimated rank.
help.confidence: More analysed moves make the result more reliable: High from 40 moves, Medium from 16.
help.match: A score combining AI first choices, good moves and mistakes; higher is closer to the AI.
help.firstChoice: Share of moves identical to the AI's first choice; higher is better.
help.top3: Share of moves among the AI's top three choices.
help.goodMoves: Share of moves that lose almost nothing, AI first choices included; higher is better.
help.avgScoreLoss: Points lost per move against the AI's best move; lower is better.
help.avgWinrateLoss: Winrate lost per move against the AI's best move; lower is better.
help.mistakeRate: Share of mistakes and blunders; lower is better.

benchmark.title: KataGo performance tuning
benchmark.subtitle: Quick official tuning runs KataGo's own benchmark with the current model on this hardware and applies the threads and batch size it recommends. The model stays the same.
benchmark.nnSpeedHint: Neural network evaluations this computer completes per second
benchmark.starting: Pausing analysis and starting KataGo's benchmark…
benchmark.explanation: NN speed shows what the hardware and model can compute; search speed shows how fast games are analysed.
benchmark.duration: Takes about 7–15 minutes. Analysis pauses meanwhile; you can stop at any time, and closing this window does not stop it.
benchmark.b11: B11 favours strength and usually computes more slowly than B10. A lower speed does not mean a weaker engine.
